_about: Rover profiles for the route engine (PROMPT.md 5.9: the rover follows its own cost surface, and serves as a mobile comms relay). Every value is PLACEHOLDER unless a source is given.

speed_go_m_s.label: PLACEHOLDER
speed_go_m_s.note: Driving speed on rover-go ground (Phase 2 rover walkability class 0).

speed_caution_m_s.label: PLACEHOLDER
speed_caution_m_s.note: Driving speed on rover-caution ground (class 1); no-go ground is impassable.

relay_sites.label: PLACEHOLDER
relay_sites.note: Relay sites chosen besides the staging point.

relay_spacing_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
relay_spacing_m.note: Spacing of the candidate relay grid.

relay_max_distance_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
relay_max_distance_m.note: Candidate relay sites lie within this distance of the staging point.

viewshed_range_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
viewshed_range_m.note: Line-of-sight range from the rover antenna.
